issue_request: FHIR-25041 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Conformance and asked for clearer CapabilityStatement guidance about search qualifiers, the distinction between SearchParameter declarations and search behavior modifiers, and support for behaviors such as _sort.
initial_application: Commit 8f6ce81 added the CapabilityStatement Supporting Search notes and a link from source/search.html for FHIR-25041. Follow-up history repaired the link markup and later wrapped the server sentence as a conformance statement, but retained wording that servers declare search features they require.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread shows the original implementer confusion around underscore controls, _include/_revinclude, modifiers, and server-specific SearchParameter resources. FHIR-I minutes for 2020-04-06 approved adding CapabilityStatement notes about search capability. Later related Jira issues FHIR-43332, FHIR-46110, and FHIR-51160 concern broader or later mechanisms/comments and were treated as context rather than decided in this Applied/Published seed run.
reconciliation: Edited source/search.html, an active top-level Search page referenced by source/hierarchy.xml, changing the linked CapabilityStatement declaration wording from server features they require to server features they support and client features they use. This aligns the Search page with source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-notes.xml, which already says CapabilityStatement indicates search functionality a server supports or a client uses.
